စက်ဖြင့် မှတ်အပ်သည်။
DOP: cakka n. [ S., BHS cakra], 1. a wheel ( i ) of a cart or carriage ; Abh 373 (~aṃ rathaṅgam ākhyātaṃ); 781; Vin I 231, 37 (Ambapālī … Licchavīnaṃ īsāya īsaṃ yugena yugaṃ ~ena ~aṃ akkhena akkhaṃ paṭivattesi); D II 343, 14 (kaddamamakkhitehi ~ehi gadrabharathena); A I 111, 11 (rathakāro chahi māsehi chārattūnehi ekaṃ ~aṃ niṭṭhāpesi); Dhp 1 (tato naṃ dukkham anveti ~aṃ va vahato padaṃ); Ja I 429, 28* (sāyaṃ vipakkhikā seti hatā ~ena sāḷikā; 430, 4´ : yānacakkena hatā); V 445, 16* (~assa nemi viya parivattati); Mil 27, 4 (~āni ratho ti, na hi bhante ti); Sp 59, 2 (ekena ~ena sīmaṃ akkamitvā ratho tiṭṭhatu); 850, 26 (yānaṃ kaddame laggati, daharo ~aṃ gahetvā ukkhipati); Mhv 21:17 (vacchakaṃ … gīvaṃ akkamma ~ena asañcicca aghātayi); 21:18 (ten’ eva ~ena sīsaṃ puttassa chedayi); — the pattern of a wheel on the soles of the foot (one of the marks of a mahāpurisa, see meaning 4 below ); Abh 781 (lakkhaṇe … ~aṃ); D III 143, 10 (mahāpurisassa hetthā pādatalesu ~āni jātāni honti sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni) = M II 136, 9 ; Ap 20, 18 (sahassārāni ~āni dissanti caraṇuttame); Ps III 375, 4 foll. ; Sadd 521, 13 ; — ( ii ) a potter’s wheel; the wheel (ie grinding stone?) of a mill ; Abh 782 (~aṃ … kulālabhaṇḍe); Ja IV 4, 5 (idaṃ maṃ ~aṃ saṇhakaraṇiyaṃ viya tilāni piṃsamānaṃ otarati); V 291, 2 (ekaṃ mattikāpiṇḍaṃ ~e ṭhapetvā ~aṃ āvijjhi); Bv 2:167 (telayante yathā ~aṃ evaṃ kampati medinī; Bv-a 114, 31 : yathā ~an ti cakkikānaṃ mahācakkayantaṃ viya); As 115, 22 (kumbhakārassa daṇḍappahārena ~aṃ bhamayitvā bhājanaṃ karontassa); — ifc see kulāla- sv kulāla 1 ; — 2. a circular missile, a discus ; Abh 394; 782 (~aṃ … āyudhe); D I 52, 27 (khurapariyantena ce pi ~ena yo imissā paṭhaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya) = M I 404, 27 = S III 208, 26 ; Ja IV 82, 17 (Vasudevo ~aṃ khipi, taṃ dvinnaṃ pi bhātikānaṃ sīsāni pātesi); Pv-a 111, 22 (Vāsudevādayo bhātaro … sabbe rājāno ~ena jīvita-kkhayaṃ pāpetvā); Sadd 521, 24 (khurapariyantena ce pi ~enā ti ettha paharaṇacakke); — ifc see asani- ( sv asanī ); — 3. a wheel or discus as an instrument of torture ; Abh 781; Ja III 206, 22* (yaṃ me sirasmiṃ ohacca ~aṃ bhamati matthake); 207, 25 (Mittavindikaṃ pana kathentam eva nipiṃsamānaṃ taṃ ~aṃ bhassi, tena so puna kathetuṃ nāsakkhi, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be khura-cakkaṃ); IV 4, 24* (icchāhatassa posassa ~aṃ bhamati matthake; 5, 22´ : tassa te icchāhatassa posassa idaṃ ~aṃ matthakaṃ nipiṃsamānaṃ idāni kumbhakāracakkaṃ viya matthake bhamatī ti attho); — ifc see ura- ( sv ura[s] ), khura- ( sv khura 1 ); — 4. the “wheel” of sovereignty, of authority; sway; (extracted from cakkavatti(n) qv below? ); Abh 782 (~aṃ … āṇāyam); D III 149, 11* (sace na pabbajjam upeti tādiso vatteti ~aṃ paṭhaviṃ pasāsati); A I 110, 3 foll. (rājā cakkavattī … dhammen’ eva ~aṃ pavatteti, taṃ hoti ~aṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ kenaci manussabhūtena paccatthikena pāṇinā; Mp II 179, 27 foll. : taṃ tena evaṃ pavattitaṃ āṇācakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ hoti); III 148, 24 (rañño cakkavattissa jeṭṭho putto pitarā pavattitaṃ ~aṃ dhammen’ eva anupavatteti); Sn 554 (rājā ’ham asmi Selā ti bhagavā dhammarājā anuttaro, dhammena ~aṃ vattemi ~aṃ appativattiyaṃ); 684 (aggapuggalo … vattessati ~aṃ Isivhaye vane); Ja III 412, 7* (dada bhuñja ca mā ca pamādo ~aṃ vattaya Kosalādhipa; cf 412, 13´ foll. : kusalajjhāsaya mahārāja paṭirūpadesa-vāsādikaṃ catubbidhaṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattehi; cf also Ps II 27, 21 foll. : cakkasaddo … dada bhuñja ca mā ca pamādo ~aṃ vattaya sabbapāṇinan ti ettha dāne); Bv 2:211 (vatti ~aṃ mahāvīro, Be, Ce so; Ee wr cakkuṃ; Se vattacakko); — ifc see dhamma- ( sv dhamma 1 ); — see also cakkaratana below; — 5. an attainment, success, accomplishment (as a means, as wheels are a means to progress?; cf Sn 260); Abh 781 (~aṃ sampattiyaṃ); D III 276, 6 (cattāri ~āni, paṭirūpa-desavāso sappurisūpassayo attasammāpaṇidhi pubbe ca katapuññatā ime cattāro dhammā bahukārā); A II 32, 2 foll. (cattār’ imāni … ~āni yehi samannāgatānaṃ devamanussānaṃ catucakkaṃ pavattati, yehi samannāgatā devamanussā na cirass’ eva mahantataṃ vepullataṃ pāpuṇanti bhogesu … paṭirūpadesavāso … pubbe ca katapuññatā; Mp III 63, 16 : ~ānī ti sampattiyo); Ja III 412, 13´ foll. (paṭirūpadesavāsādikaṃ catubbidhaṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattehi, pakatiratho hi dvīhi ~ehi gacchati ayaṃ pana kāyo imehi catūhi ~ehi devalokaṃ gacchati tena te dhammacakkan ti saṅkhyaṃ gatā); As 58, 25 (paṭirūpadesavāso … pubbe ca katapuññatā ti cattāri ~āni vuttāni, tāni vā ekajjhaṃ katvā okāsaṭṭhena khaṇo ti veditabbāni, tāni hi kusaluppattiyā okāsabhūtāni); — ifc see catu- sv catu(r ), dhamma- ( sv dhamma 1 ); — 6. a circle ; Abh 781 (~aṃ … maṇḍale); Mil 51, 10 foll. (thero paṭhaviyā ~aṃ ālikhitvā Milindaṃ rājānaṃ etad avoca, atthi mahārāja imassa ~assa anto ti, natthi bhante ti); — ifc see alāta-, joti-; — 7. a circle of possible cases, a series of permutations ; Vin I 330, 16 (yathā heṭṭhā tathā ~aṃ kātabbaṃ); III 170, 25 (ekekaṃ mūlaṃ kātūna ~aṃ bandhitabbaṃ); Sp 1148, 11 (adhammena vaggaṃ adhammena samaggaṃ dhammena vaggaṃ dhammapaṭirūpakena vaggaṃ dhammapaṭirūpakena samaggan ti imesaṃ vasena ~aṃ bandhitvā); — 8. a posture ; Abh 781 (iriyāpathe ~aṃ); Spk I 53, 3 (catucakkan ti catu-iriyāpathaṃ, iriyāpatho hi idha ~an ti adhippeto); Sadd 521, 13 ; — ifc see catu- ( sv catu[r] ); — 9. a force, a troop of soldiers ; Abh 381 (camū ~aṃ balaṃ); 781 (~aṃ … bale); — 10. giving, generosity ; Abh 782 (~aṃ … dānarāsisu); Ps II 27, 30 (cakkasaddo … dada bhuñja ca mā ca pamādo ~aṃ vattaya sabbapāṇinan ti ettha dāne; cf Ja III 412, 6* foll. above ) ≠ Sadd 521, 13 foll. ; — 11. a multitude ; Abh 782 (~aṃ … dānarāsisu); — 12. a branch of knowledge or skill (probably in augury) ; — ifc see antara-, miga-, sā- ( sv sa 6 ); — °’- aṅkita , mfn. , marked with a wheel ; Ja I 231, 10 (sā ~esu satthu pādesu nipatitvā); Ap 467, 2 (jālinā ~ena mudukomalapāṇinā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee saṅkhalaṅkena); 532, 24 (~e pādatale); — ° âticakka , n. ( and m. ?), wheel(s) on wheel(s);? cart(s) on cart(s) ;? Ja II 253, 14 (rājaṅgaṇe ~e mañcātimañce bandhiṃsu); 331, 22 (kumārassa yasaṃ passissāmā ti sakalanagaraṃ saṅkhubhi, pāsādantare ~āni mañcātimañcāni bandhanti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~aṃ); IV 81, 25 (~aṃ mañcātimañcaṃ bandhiṃsu); — ° ânuvattaka , mfn. and m. , (one) who turns the wheel afterwards, who keeps the wheel rolling ; Th 1014 (~o thero; Th-a III 105, 8 : ~o ti satthārā vattitassa dhammacakkassa anuvattako); Bv 6:8 (yo so paññāya asamo tassa ~o); — °- cchinna , mfn. , churned up by the wheels; dried up, lessened, because of the wheels ; D II 128, 27 (idāni … pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni atikkantāni, taṃ ~aṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati) = Ud 83, 11 ; — °- dhāri(n) , mfn. , bearing the wheel (of torture) ; Ja III 207, 18* (ye ca taṃ anugijjhanti te honti ~ino; 207, 23´ : khuracakkaṃ dhārentī ti); IV 4, 28* ; — °- pāṇī̆ , m ( fn )., (the one) who has a discus in his hand, the god Viṣṇu; Abh 16 (vāsudevo hari kaṇho kesavo ~i); Samantak 724; — °- bhañjanī , ( m ) f ( n )., destroying attainments or good fortune ;? ( None ;?) Ja V 113, 2* (usuyyake du-hadaye purise kammadussake kālakaṇṇī mahārāja ramati ~ī; 114, 27´ : evaṃ sā kālakaṇṇī mahārāja ramati patirūpa-desavāsādino kusalacakkassa bhañjanī); — °- bheda , m. , breaking the wheel of authority, destroying the unity or sway of the religion ; Vin II 196, 32 (mayaṃ āvuso samaṇassa Gotamassa saṅghabhedaṃ karissāma ~an ti) = III 171, 8 ; III 172, 20 (kathaṃ nāma Devadatto bhagavato saṅghabhedāya parakkamissati ~āyā ti; Sp 607, 15 : ~āyā ti āṇābhedāya); — °- yanta , n. , an instrument with a wheel, a mill; a turning machine ; Vism 674, 28 foll. (eko … issāso … ~e aṭṭhāsi, añño puriso ~aṃ āvijjhitvā …); Ps I 65, 9 (~e niyuttabalivaddo viya … āvaṭṭaparivaṭṭaṃ karoti); Spk III 50, 27 (yojanikaṃ madhubhaṇḍaṃ ~ena pīḷetvā madhupānaṃ pāyamāno viya); — °- yuga , n. , a pair of wheels ; A I 111, 7 (sakkhasi me samma rathakāra navaṃ ~aṃ kātun ti); Vv 83:2 (uppanno rathapañjaro mama tassa ~aṃ na vindami) = Ja IV 60, 17* ; — °- ratana , n. [cakka + ratana 1 ], 1. “the wheel-treasure” (one of the seven ratana s of a cakkavatti(n) emperor, symbol of his sovereignty and sway, which appears in the sky and moves over the emperor’s territory; it also apparently has the power to transport the emperor to other worlds) ; D II 172, 16 (dibbaṃ ~aṃ … sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ); 172, 19 foll. (rājā Mahāsudassano … vāmena hatthena bhiṅkāraṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena ~aṃ abbhukkiri pavattatu bhavaṃ ~aṃ abhivijinātu bhavaṃ ~an ti); 173, 1 (yasmiṃ kho … padese ~aṃ patiṭṭhāsi tattha rājā Mahāsudassano vāsaṃ upagacchi saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya); III 59, 4 ; 59, 30 (yassa rañño cakkavattissa dibbaṃ ~aṃ osakkati ṭhānā cavati na dāni tena raññā ciraṃ jīvitabbaṃ hotī ti); Ja I 63, 19 (Māro … mārisa mā nikkhami, ito te sattame divase ~aṃ pātubhavissati dvisahassaparittadīpa-parivārānaṃ catunnaṃ mahādīpānaṃ rajjaṃ kāressasi, nivatta mārisā ti āha); II 311, 24 foll. (so ~aṃ abbhukkiritvā saddhiṃ parisāya cātumahārājikadeva-lokaṃ agamāsi … pariṇāyakaratanaṃ ~aṃ ādāya saddhiṃ parisāya manussapathaṃ otaritvā attano nagaram eva pāvisi); Mil 107, 21 foll. (yathā mahārāja cakkavattirājā yadā ~aṃ sarati upetu me ~an ti sarite ~aṃ upeti); Ps I 225, 33 foll. ; IV 215, 2 foll. (puññakammapaccayaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ nīlamaṇi-saṅghātasadisaṃ pācīnasamuddajalatalaṃ chindamānaṃ viya ākāsaṃ alaṅkurumānaṃ viya dibbaṃ ~aṃ pātubhavati); 218, 1 (n’ ev’ esa puṇṇacando na suriyo na devavimānaṃ, na h’ etesaṃ evarūpā sirisampatti atthi, ~ena pan’ etena bhavitabban ti); 219, 5 foll. ; Vibh-a 436, 34 (dvidhā ~assa antaradhānaṃ hoti cakka-vattino kālakiriyāya vā pabbajjāya vā); — 2. the pattern of the wheel on the soles of the feet ; Bv 2:218 (sā ca iddhi so ca yaso tāni ca pādesu ~āni); — °- vaṭṭaka , m. or n. , a wheeled device for raising water from a well, a noria ; Vin II 122, 16 (anujānāmi bhikkhave tulaṃ kara-kaṭakaṃ ~an ti, bhājanā bahuṃ bhijjanti; Sp 1208, 9 : ~an ti arahaṭaghaṭiyantaṃ); — °- vatti(n) , m ( fn ). and m. [ see K.R. Norman, 1969, pp. 241–42 (= 2007a, pp. 274–5) ], (a king) whose sovereignty and sway extend over the whole earth; a universal emperor ; Abh 335; D I 88, 33 (āgatāni … amhākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa mahā-purisassa dve gatiyo bhavanti anaññā, sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati rājā hoti ~i dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratana-samannāgato … sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivatta-cchaddo; Sv 249, 24 foll. : cakkaratanaṃ vatteti catuhi sampatticakkehi vattati tehi ca paraṃ vatteti parahitāya ca iriyāpathacakkānaṃ vatto etasmiṃ atthī ti ~ī, ettha ca rājā ti sāmaññaṃ ~ī ti visesanaṃ); II 172, 13 foll. (yassa rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa … dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ pātubhavati … so hoti rājā ~ī ti); S I 191, 12 (seyyathā pi … rañño ~issa jeṭṭhaputto pitarā pavattitaṃ cakkaṃ samma-d-eva anupavatteti, evam eva kho tvaṃ Sāriputta mayā anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ samma-d-eva anupavattesī ti); A I 28, 5 foll. (yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā dve rājāno ~ī apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjeyyuṃ n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati … yaṃ itthī rājā assa ~ī n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati); 109, 18 (yo pi so … rājā ~ī dhammiko dhammarājā so pi na arājakaṃ cakkaṃ vattetī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se so pi nāma arājakaṃ); III 365, 8 (ye keci khuddarājāno sabbe te rañño ~issa anuyuttā bhavanti, rājā tesaṃ ~i aggam akkhāyati); Sn 552 (rāja arahasi bhavituṃ ~i rathesabho cāturanto vijitāvī jambusaṇḍassa issaro); Ja II 395, 2* (idaṃ phalaṃ bhutvā dohaḷiṇī nārī ~iṃ vijāyati); Ap 513, 5 (tato cutā manussatte rājūnaṃ ~inaṃ maṇḍalīnaṃ ca rājūnaṃ mahesittaṃ akārayiṃ); Bv 13:11 (ahaṃ tena samayena catudīpamhi issaro antalikkhacaro āsiṃ ~ī mahabbalo); Vibh 336, 29 (rājāno ~ino); Ps IV 221, 4 (vāsaṃ upagate ~imhi); 225, 21 (mahiddhikaṃ ~ino hatthiratanaṃ hoti); Spk III 152, 18 (pavattatu bhavaṃ cakkaratanan ti puññānubhāvena abbhuggatāya vācāya codento cakkaṃ vattetī ti ~i); — ifc see saddhamma- sv sa(t ); — ~-kolāhala, n. , uproar about (the appearance of) a cakkavatti(n) emperor ; Spk I 130, 32 ; Pj I 121, 9 (kāmāvacaradevā eva vassasatassa accayena ~ī rājā loke uppajjissatī ti manussapathe vicaritvā ārocenti idaṃ ~-kolāhalaṃ nāma); Ap-a 52, 24 ; — ~-halāhala, n. , uproar about (the appearance of) a cakkavatti(n) emperor ; Ja I 48, 11 (~-halāhalaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~-kolāhalaṃ); — °- vāka , m. , the Cakra bird (the ruddy sheldrake?) ; Abh 641; Ja III 520, 21 (suvaṇṇavaṇṇe dve ~e sevāle khāditvā vasante disvā); V 406, 2* (haṃsā koñcā mayūrā ca ~ā ca kukkuhā); Ap 44, 2 (sadā rakkhanti rājānaṃ ~o va dukkhitaṃ; Ap-a 285, 19 foll. : dukkhappattaṃ sakaṃ ñātiṃ rakkhanto ~o pakkhī ivā ti attho); 113, 2 (~o ahaṃ tadā; Ap-a 387, 15 : cakkaṃ sīghaṃ gacchantaṃ iva udake vā thale vā ākāse vā sīghaṃ vāti gacchatī ti ~o); Mil 401, 18 foll. (~o yāva jīvitapariyādānā dutiyikaṃ na vijahati … ~o sevālapaṇakabhakkho … ~o pāṇe na viheṭhayati); — ~âbhikūjita, mfn. , resounding with the calls of cakkavāka birds ; Pv 24:3; — ~’ūpakūjita, mfn. , echoing to the calls of cakkavāka birds ; Ja IV 359, 1* (imā pokkharaṇiyo rammā ~’ūpakūjitā); Ap 333, 17 (pokkharaṇī ~’ūpakūjitā, Ce so; Se ~’upakujjitā; Be cakkavākapakūjitā; Ee wr cakkavākā pakūjitā) ≠ 362, 26 ( Be, Ce so; Se ~’upakujjitā; Ee cakkavākapakūjitā); — °- vākī , f. , the female Cakra bird ; Ja III 524, 9 (~ī Rāhulamātā cakkavāko aham evā ti); VI 189, 11* (sā nūna ~ī va pallalasmiṃ anūdake); — °- vāḷa , n.m. , 1. ( n. [ and m. ?]) one of innumerable worlds, encircled by a cakkavāḷa mountain-range, containing four continents ; Ja I 203, 22 (addhā aññehi pi ~ehi Sakkā āgacchanti); Ap 380, 19 (~am upādāya sakānanaṃ sapabbataṃ); Bv 1:64 (sattakāyo ca ākāso ~ā c’ anantakā; Bv-a 52, 22 : ākāsassa pi anto natthi tathā ~āni anantāni eva); Vism 205, 20 (ekaṃ ~aṃ āyāmato ca vitthārato ca yojanānaṃ dvādasasatasahassāni catuttiṃsasatāni ca paññāsaṃ ca yojanāni); Ps III 373, 19 (~aṃ atisambādhaṃ bhavaggaṃ atinīcaṃ); IV 114, 13 foll. (ṭhapetvā imaṃ ~aṃ aññasmiṃ ~e buddhā uppajjantī ti suttaṃ natthi, na uppajjantī ti pana atthi); 121, 16 foll. (ekissā lokadhātuyā ti ekasmiṃ ~e … buddhā hi uppajjamānā imasmiṃ yeva ~e uppajjanti); 177, 13 (tiṇṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ ~ānaṃ antarā ekekā lokantarikā hoti, tiṇṇaṃ sakaṭacakkānaṃ pattānaṃ vā aññamaññaṃ āhacca ṭhapitānaṃ majjhe okāso viya); V 7, 18 (dasahi ~-sahassehi sannipatitāhi devatāhi parivuto); Spk II 159, 25 foll. ( m. ) the mountain-range believed to encircle a world ; Vism 421, 14 (~ā ~ehi himavantā himavantehi Sinerū Sinerūhi aññamaññaṃ samāgantvā cuṇṇavicuṇṇā hutvā vinassanti; or world ?); Sv 446, 1 (samuddo ~o himavā Sineru candimasuriya-nakkhattādīni …); Spk III 76, 1 (~aṃ vā sineruṃ vā āhacca); — ~’-addika, m. , the mountain-range believed to encircle a world ; Samantak 767 (himālayo ~’-addiko ca); — ~-gabbha, m. , what is within the cakkavāḷa mountain range; the interior of a world ; Mp III 319, 7 (~-gabbhaṃ pūretvā ṭhitā mahāpaṭhavī); Dhp-a IV 74, 18 ; — ~-pabbata, m. , the mountain-range believed to encircle a world ; Ja III 32, 16´ (samuddaṃ parivāretvā ṭhitena ~-pabbatena saddhiṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee samudde); Vism 421, 9 (~-pabbataṃ pi sinerupabbataṃ pi vāto ukkhipitvā ākāse khipati); Sp 1137, 5 foll. cakkana.p: [Cakka+yu¿] (pu) CL=8 Who is the named Cakkana. See original
pn: Cakkana. An upāsaka of Ceylon. While he was a boy, his mother once fell grievously ill and the doctors ordered her hare’s flesh. Cakkana was sent by his brother into the field, where he caught a hare which, however, out of compassion he set free. His brother blamed him, but Cakkana cured his mother by a saccakiriyā, saying that, inasmuch as he had never deprived anything of life, by the power of that truth his mother should recover (SN-a.ii.112; the story is slightly different in MN-a.i.165). Cakkana’s abstinence is one that was maintained “in spite of opportunity” (sampattivirati) and when he had not undertaken to observe any precept. Dhs-a., p. 103.
